title: The impact of saleable floor areas on residential prices
key_point: HK agents required to quote saleable not gross area from end-2012; high efficiency-ratio flats expected to command premiums.

title: Hong Kong Monthly August 2026
key_point: July 2026 HK primary sales 796 (-60% MoM); deals quoted per saleable sq ft; sea-view premises draw strong enquiry.

title: Tokyo mid-market residential rents up 7.1% in 2025
key_point: Tokyo 23-ward rents +7.1% YoY to JPY4,639/sqm; central five wards +9.0%; wage growth, inflows drive demand.

title: Singapore HDB resale prices dip 0.3% in Q2
key_point: HDB RPI -0.3% QoQ Q2 2026; record 491 million-dollar resales; 94+ year-lease flats 5.9% of deals.

title: KE Holdings: The Most Interesting Real Estate Company in the World
key_point: Beike ACN ~406k agents; Housing Dictionary true listings; VR tours on ~70% of listings; GTV ~$378bn 2022.

title: Elite School Designation and Housing Prices: Quasi-experimental Evidence from Beijing, China
publisher: Journal of Housing Economics (Huang, He, Xu, Zhu)
key_point: Matching DiD on Lianjia/Fang data 2013-16: municipal key primary school eligibility adds 4-8%, district-level 2-3%.

title: Residential Property Price Indexes for Tokyo
publisher: UBC School of Economics DP 13-07 (Diewert, Shimizu)
key_point: Each extra walk minute cuts land value 0.35% (2-8 min) but ~2% (8-13 min); depreciation 2.5%/yr first decade.

title: Superstition in the Housing Market
publisher: AEA conference paper (Fortin, Hill, Huang, UBC)
key_point: Vancouver addresses ending 4 sell ~CAD8k less, ending 8 ~CAD10k more where Chinese share >=18%; reviews HK lucky-floor study.

title: COV Discussion
key_point: Buyers report COV from $0 to $90k; floor, view, MRT/hub proximity, MOP status drive COV.

title: HDB Resale Valuation
key_point: Valuers weigh recent transactions, floor, MOP, amenities; renovation disputed; corner units value higher; don't gamble on valuation.

title: First property purchase
key_point: Old HK flats unpopular with buyers and banks; mortgage capped by building age except blue-chip estates; buy ~5-year-old.

title: Walking minutes to station accuracy (e-mansion BBS)
key_point: Japanese listings must use 80m per minute along roads, ignoring slopes and signals; buyers doubt advertised times.

title: TLUG mailing list: finding an apartment without a guarantor
key_point: Foreigner refused by most Tokyo agencies without personal guarantor; replies suggest Leopalace or employer as guarantor.

title: What specifics to look out for when buying a resale HDB
key_point: Single expert answer: old resale HDBs appreciate least; prefer constantly high-demand MRT-adjacent locations; lease decay key.

title: Centa-City Index
publisher: City University of Hong Kong / Centaline
key_point: Hedonic HK index adjusts for floor area, age, location, direction, view, floor level; weekly CCL uses Centaline contracts.

title: HSBC Property Valuation tool
key_point: Online valuation by estate, block, floor, flat; shows saleable/gross area, age; Cushman & Wakefield data, non-binding.

title: P1 Registration: Home-School Distance
key_point: Oversubscribed schools prioritise citizens within 1km, then 1-2km; must live at address 30 months.

title: More flexibility to buy a home for life while safeguarding retirement adequacy
key_point: From May 2019 CPF use pro-rated unless remaining lease covers youngest buyer to age 95.

title: Can We Expect Cash Over Valuation (COV) To Keep Climbing For HDB Flats?
key_point: 1 in 3 resale flats had COV; typical $15-20k, $40-50k for jumbo/maisonette; HDB stopped publishing COV 2014.

title: Do Property Superstitions Really Affect Profits? We Look At 26 Years Of Data
key_point: 160,408 private resales: units numbered 4/14/44 outperformed 8/88 on gains, except in Core Central Region.

title: HDB lease decay and Bala's curve: flat values at the 60-year mark
key_point: Bala's curve ~96% value at 99 years, ~80% at 60, ~75% at 50; decay steepens below 60 years.

title: How to buy a flat / apartment in Hong Kong
key_point: Check efficiency ratio (80%+ good), bank valuations, transaction records; buyers wary of 20+ year buildings; MTR, school nets valued.

title: Chiku-nen (year built): Real Estate Japan's word of the day
key_point: Post-1 June 1981 shin-taishin buildings survived Hanshin quake far better; build year a standard listing filter.

title: Why your rental application is getting rejected
key_point: Income 36x monthly rent; guarantor companies preferred; 2016 survey ~39% foreigners refused for not being Japanese.

title: Is a 20-Minute Walk Too Far? Choosing an Apartment Within Walking Distance to the Station
key_point: 80m per minute standard; 31% call 10 minutes close; 5 vs 10 minute walk changes rent JPY10-20k.

title: Why your apartment rental application is getting rejected as a foreigner
key_point: About 40% of foreigners face rejection; guarantor firms charge 0.5-1 month rent plus renewals.

title: Why renting an apartment in Japan is challenging for foreigners
key_point: Upfront costs 4-6 months rent incl. 1-2 months reikin and shikikin; 'no foreigners' listings persist.

title: Resale Value Trends in Tokyo Condominiums
key_point: Vendor index: 6-10 minute walk ~92%, 11-15 minutes ~85% of within-5-minute price; low reliability.

title: What Is Jeonse? Korea's Unique Housing Deposit System Explained
key_point: Jeonse lump-sum deposit, no rent, 2 years; Seoul studios can need KRW100m+; jeonse fraud rising.

title: Gangnam-gu Apartment Jeonse Prices Rose 9.32% Since Second Half of Last Year
key_point: Gangnam jeonse +9.32% vs Seoul 4.26% (KB data) driven by school-district demand after high-school reforms.

title: Seoul apartment prices in education districts
key_point: Daechi-dong, Jamwon-dong hagwon and school clusters push prices despite regulation; Gangnam units up KRW25-100m.

title: KB Kookmin mortgage limits for DH Bangbae
key_point: KB lends lower of 60% sale price or 50% appraisal; regulated-zone 600m won cap; market price exceeds sale price.

title: Starting price for Seoul's top 1% of apartments reaches 4.7 billion won
key_point: H1 2026 Seoul top-1% threshold KRW4.65bn; Han River, Gangnam redevelopments; loan curbs cooled from 5bn.

title: A Brand Premium on Apartment Prices: Evidences from Renaming Cases
key_point: Abstract only: brand-related renaming raises Seoul apartment prices; effect fades within about a year, no spillover.

title: Analysis of the effect of brands of apartment complexes on house prices using hedonic OLS
key_point: Abstract only: decomposes Korean apartment price into physical, neighbourhood and brand (intangible) components.

title: Why a newer apartment may cost up to 4x the price of an older one
key_point: Snippet: under-5-year units 49% more per sqm than 30+ year units in 23 wards; 3.7x in Saitama.

title: Building age vs. distance from station - which has the biggest impact on rent?
key_point: Snippet: age gap (<3 vs 30 years) 30-40% rent; station gap (<3 vs 11-15 min) ~20%.

title: HDB near MRT: how much more
key_point: Snippet: within 500m of MRT ~8% premium; negative in central area (no-MRT flats 42% dearer).

title: A small area of concern
key_point: Snippet: efficiency ratios fell from ~90% (1970s) to ~75%; saleable psf ~30% above gross psf.

title: Haunted forever: Hong Kong homes with history of murder are hard sell
key_point: Snippet: death-incident flats typically sell at 10-20% discount (Centaline); 20-40% for notorious cases.
